evidence.title: Create beautiful images of your code

name: Ray
summary: Turns code into shareable images with syntax colors, background and light/dark window; also hosts snippet and quicklink explorers.
description: Paste code, choose a syntax color theme, hide or show the background and toggle between a dark and light window, then download an image of the snippet. The same site hosts a Snippet Explorer (snippets grouped by category) and a Quicklink Explorer whose entries can be imported into Raycast.
contains: paste code and choose syntax colors, background on/off, dark or light window, padding and font settings
exports an image of the code to share or download
Snippet Explorer: 134 snippets in 10 categories (Symbols 47, Coding 16, Arrows 14, Currency 13 …)
Quicklink Explorer: 136 quicklinks in 10 categories (Development 34, Search 22, Socials 13, Entertainment 12 …)
snippets and quicklinks import directly into Raycast
